app.bootNoDesktopTitle: Start Your Adventure with SaveHub Desktop
app.bootNoDesktopDesc: Saving and restoring files requires the Electron desktop app.
app.bootNoDesktopHint: Or launch the packaged SaveHub application.
app.errorBoundaryDesc: Your saved records remain safely in your local vault.

sidebar.localVaultDesc: Every save stays right on your device.
sidebar.footerSlogan: Keep a doorway open for your next adventure.

library.headingDesc: Preserve your courage at this moment and return to the worlds you love anytime.
library.footerQuote: Every return is a new beginning.
library.emptyLibraryTitle: Build a Home for Your Adventures.
library.emptyLibraryDesc: Add your first game to start managing its saves and every fresh start.

games.headingDesc: Each game is managed independently, giving every adventure its own space.
games.selectAll: Select all games in this list
games.recordHint: Record counts include saves, trash and restore points.
games.missingPath: No path configured for this system
games.deleteDesc: Game settings and saves are kept by default and can be restored from All Games → Deleted Games. The option below permanently removes the game settings, vault directory and all records.
games.deleteCheckbox: Permanently delete all save records for this game
games.deleteWarning: Physically deletes the game settings, entire game vault directory and {count} records, including protected, favorite and trashed saves and restore points. This cannot be undone. The original game save directory is unaffected.
games.deleteSuccess: Game deleted; settings and save records retained.
games.purgeSuccess: Game settings, vault directory and all saves permanently deleted.
games.exportDesc: Export settings for {count} games, including names, icons, colors and Windows / macOS paths.
games.exportHint: Includes all saves, favorite and protection flags, trash and restore points. Leave unchecked to export settings only.
games.exportSuccess: Exported {count} games and {saves} save records to {folder}
games.importRules: Duplicates match game identity or name. Overwrite replaces settings while retaining saves; keep both creates a numbered game; skipping a game also skips its bundled saves.
games.reviewIntro: Process {games} game settings and {saves} saves, including {duplicates} duplicate saves.
games.reviewHint: Saves follow the same conflict rules as individual imports. Nothing is written until execution. Check local game paths after importing.
games.resultDesc: Game settings and saves were processed separately as shown below. Source files were retained.

themes.headingTitle: A New Mood for Your Next Journey.
themes.headingDesc: Four distinct styles, one shared passion. Choose the space that fits your world.
themes.noteDesc: Themes apply instantly and save automatically for the next time you launch.
themes.inkDesc: Rice-paper texture, distant ink mountains, and a touch of vermilion—resting your adventures in calm whitespace.
themes.techDesc: Ice-blue light passes through translucent panels while precision grids outline a futuristic order.
themes.cyberDesc: Electric cyan and neon magenta intertwine with glitch accents and glowing borders to ignite the night.
themes.glassDesc: Soft colors diffuse through frosted glass as translucent surfaces float gently in light and shadow.

settings.headingTitle: Stored Safely, Ready Whenever You Are.
settings.headingDesc: Everything stays local on your device, under your control.
settings.languageDesc: Switch the display language for the application. Your choice is saved automatically.
settings.vaultDesc: Game profiles, icons, and save backups are stored at the path below. Uninstalling the app does not delete your vault.
settings.safetyIntegrityDesc: Every backup and restore verifies SHA-256 checksums and stops immediately if any anomaly is detected.
settings.safetyAutoBackupDesc: Automatically saves your current progress to Restore Points before replacing any files.
settings.safetyRollbackDesc: Rolls back automatically if replacement fails, and recovers unfinished transactions on next startup.
settings.removedGamesDesc: Recover, permanently delete or retry cleanup of removed games in All Games.
settings.logsDesc: Logs are grouped by type and operation and share one capacity limit, defaulting to 20 MB (1 MB = 1,048,576 bytes). Oldest records are removed when the limit is exceeded.

snapshots.sectionDesc: Favorites are for starring; protected saves must be unprotected before deletion.
snapshots.tabScopeDesc: all {count} save(s) in the "{tab}" tab, regardless of search
snapshots.batchProtectedTrashHint: · Includes protected saves (recover and unprotect to delete)
snapshots.batchIdleTrashHint: Select saves to batch recover, permanently delete, or export
snapshots.batchIdleHint: Select saves to batch protect, delete, or export
snapshots.recoverFromTrashBeforeProtectTitle: Recover saves from Trash before changing protection
snapshots.deleteSelectedProtectedTitle: Selection includes protected saves. Unprotect them first.
snapshots.legacyBannerDesc: Found {count} legacy save folder(s) ready to import from ArchiveFile.
snapshots.defaultNote: This moment is safely preserved for you.
snapshots.menuDeleteProtectedTitle: Protected saves cannot be deleted. Unprotect first.
snapshots.emptySearchDesc: Try another keyword or clear the search filter.
snapshots.emptyTrashDesc: Select items to recover, or permanently delete them from disk (cannot be undone).
snapshots.emptyFavoriteDesc: Click the star next to any save to mark it as a favorite.
snapshots.emptyProtectedDesc: Protected saves appear here and cannot be deleted until unprotected.
snapshots.emptyAllTitle: Your story begins—save your first moment
snapshots.emptyAllDesc: Close your game and create a save to mark a starting point for your next adventure.
snapshots.footnoteLeft: Automatic backups are kept in Restore Points and not counted in Total Saves.

restorePoints.description: Current progress is backed up before loading. Points are retained by modification time using global or game settings.
restorePoints.removedDesc: Recovery count cannot exceed active retention. Recovering updates modification time. Excess removed records are permanently deleted automatically.
restorePoints.protectedCannotDeleteTitle: Protected saves cannot be deleted. Unprotect them first.
restorePoints.emptyActive: No restore points yet. One is created automatically before your first restore.

import.overwriteStateHint: The local record has the states shown above. Overwriting replaces its content, name, and note while keeping these states.
import.retentionAfterImport: Restore point limits are applied after the entire import finishes. Excess records may be removed or permanently deleted.
import.protectedOverwriteHint: The local record is protected and cannot be overwritten. Choose Skip or Keep Both.
import.chooseHowToHandle: Choose how to handle each duplicate save, then apply all at once.
import.additionalNewSaves: {count} new save(s) will also be imported upon confirmation.
import.ruleOverwriteDesc: Replaces the target content, name, and note while keeping its creation time, favorite flag, and category state. Protected records cannot be overwritten.
import.ruleSkipDesc: Keeps the existing record and skips importing this item.
import.ruleKeepBothDesc: Keeps the existing record and imports a new numbered save alongside it.
import.cannotOverwriteHint: This record is damaged or has an unfinished permanent deletion. Choose Skip or Keep Both.
import.prepareFailedHeader: {count} item(s) could not be prepared for import:
import.resultDesc: Source files were preserved. Newly imported, overwritten, and coexisting saves are available in the timeline.

batchReport.permanentDesc: Some files may already be removed; records marked "Pending Deletion" can only be retried for deletion and cannot be recovered.
batchReport.softDesc: Unfinished items remain unchanged. Resolve the issues below and try again.

removeGame.question: Remove "{name}" from your games?
removeGame.desc: Existing backups will be kept and can be restored from "Settings & About → Removed Games". Live game files are untouched.

detail.emptyNote: No notes added for this save.
detail.absentNotice: This record includes paths that did not exist when saved: {paths}. Restoring it will remove those paths again.

help.intro: Leave a way back for every attempt.
help.step1Desc: Select the game save root directory in Game Settings and enter the relative file or folder paths to back up (one per line).
help.step2Desc: Give your save a memorable name and note. SaveHub copies and verifies every file with SHA-256 checksums.
help.step3Desc: Close the game and pause cloud sync before loading a save. Your current progress is backed up to Restore Points first.
help.step4Desc: Use "Import Saves" to bring in legacy ArchiveFile folders, individual save directories, or SaveHub export bundles.
help.platformNotice: Windows and macOS paths are configured separately. For Wine / CrossOver games on macOS, select the actual container save directory.

deleteConfirm.descPermanent: Permanently delete the following {count} record(s) and their files from disk?
deleteConfirm.permanentWarningDesc: Files will be physically removed from disk and cannot be recovered. Live game progress is not affected.
deleteConfirm.softFootnote: Files are kept for now. You can recover them or permanently delete them from "{destination}".
deleteConfirm.favWarningTitle: Note: This deletion includes {count} favorite save(s)
deleteConfirm.favWarningPermanentDesc: These favorite records and their files will also be permanently deleted. Confirm to proceed.
deleteConfirm.favWarningSoftDesc: Confirm that these favorite saves should also be moved. Their favorite star is kept if recovered.

gameForm.introTitle: Every world has its own name.
gameForm.introDesc: Customize game profile and connect its save folder.
gameForm.browseOtherOsTitle: Enter paths for other platforms manually
gameForm.backupItemsLabel: Files or Folders to Back Up
gameForm.backupItemsPlaceholder:
One relative path per line, e.g.:
saves
preferences
gameForm.backupItemsHint: Relative to the root directory above. Supports multiple files, folders, spaces, Unicode, and nested paths.
gameForm.macWineNotice: For games running via CrossOver / Wine, enter the actual save path inside the bottle/container.
gameForm.legacyRootHint: Used only to discover legacy ArchiveFile backups. Importing copies the original files.

snapshotForm.editDesc: Keep every checkpoint easy to recognize.
snapshotForm.createDesc: Name this moment so you can easily find it later.
snapshotForm.notePlaceholder: Record playthrough, character, location, or thoughts on this adventure…
snapshotForm.closeGameNotice: Please close the game first so save files remain consistent. All configured files and folders will be backed up together.

restoreConfirm.safetyNotice: SaveHub will automatically back up your current progress to Restore Points and verify it before restoring. If the backup fails, the restore is aborted.
restoreConfirm.replaceSummary: Will completely replace: {entries}. Extra files added in those directories will also be removed.
restoreConfirm.gameClosedWarning: I have closed the game and paused any cloud sync that writes to save files.

logs.title: Log retention
logs.zeroHint: Set to 0 to clear existing application logs and stop retaining new logs. Transaction recovery files are unaffected.
logs.invalidLimit: Enter a valid non-negative whole number for log capacity.

retention.title: Restore point retention
retention.description: Oldest modified records are removed first. Excess active points move to the removed queue; excess removed points are permanently deleted. 0 retains no records and disables recovery when used for active points.
retention.invalidCount: Retention must be a non-negative safe integer, including 0.
retention.recoveryDisabled: Active restore point retention is 0. Change retention settings before recovering records.
retention.recoveryLimit: Selected {count} records; active restore point retention is {limit}. Select fewer records.
retention.gameHint: Each value can independently override the global setting.
